slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never explicitly asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck. Its generic question about additional shipment constraints did not clearly target this hidden slot.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No truck capacity limit applies, or truck capacity is irrelevant, so the model only needs supply, demand, integrality, and no additional constraints.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed the maximum containers allowed per truck. Its broad question about additional constraints did not specifically ask about truck capacity, so the omission was an unconfirmed assumption.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Only the P2 truck-capacity slot remained unresolved; no P0 or P1 hidden slots were missed before the agent declared READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent clarified several important modeling details, including cost rate, supply/demand interpretation, integrality, and general constraints, but never explicitly asked about truck capacity. Since the missed slot is only P2, the stopping behavior is appropriate.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
